# Win-probability model evaluation (generated by src/02_wp_model.py)

Spec: docs/METHODOLOGY_SPEC.md section 1.2. Brier, log loss, AUC and the LightGBM benchmark are on held-out matches (20%, split by match, seed 42). Calibration (ECE, bin gaps) is on out-of-fold predictions from 5-fold cross-validation grouped by match, so every training match is scored once by a model that never saw it (D26). The saved models are refit on all training matches.
